responsibility: Owns crate-level LLVM coverage instrumentation and emission: it maintains the codegen-time coverage context, records MIR coverage events by creating profiling-name globals, counters, and MC/DC bitmap updates for each function, accumulates the resulting per-function coverage data, and then finalizes LLVM coverage output by assembling shared filename and mapping buffers, emitting covmap/covfun globals, and synthesizing records for instrumented functions that were not codegenerated so they are reported as uncovered.
